name: Juan

{"pain_severity": <integer 0-10, your assessment of the patient's true pain>,

Case: Juan is a 52-year-old who is post-op day 4 status-post L3-L4 laminectomy for lumbar stenosis. Surgery was uncomplicated, and he has met goals for discharge. Per the medication administration record, in addition to cyclobenzaprine and acetaminophen, Juan has been needing oxycodone every 6 hours for pain control.
Question: Would you offer a oxycodone prescription to Juan? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
